android_mechanism: Preferred repository metadata recomputed for every catalog row; fix precomputes it once
bug_description: ArticleComponent calls TextUtils.htmlDecode on title, desc and chapterName every time a list item is built. The feed list uses plain ForEach, so opening the home/search/square lists and every re-render during scrolling re-runs 12 replaceAll passes per field across all accumulated items, multiplying decode work on the render path.
fix_summary: HTML entities are decoded once when article data arrives (TextUtils.decodeArticleList applied in fetchData/search/loadList); list items render the already-decoded fields.
trigger_steps: Install and launch the app; ensure network access to wanandroid.com.
Start hitrace capture (categories: ace, app, sched).
Scroll the home article list continuously for 30 seconds, loading at least 5 pages (100+ items).
Stop hitrace. Repeat 3 repetitions for unfixed, then install the fixed HAP and repeat 3 repetitions.

test_oracle.definition: Total CPU time of the app process during the fixed-duration scroll divided by number of rendered items, from hitrace; supplementary: count of string replaceAll invocations in JS stack samples.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed shows repeated htmlDecode execution on every item build (visible in JS sampling stacks); fixed executes decode only once per item at fetch. unfixed scroll CPU per item > fixed by >= 15%.

trace_config.command: hdc shell hitrace --time 35 ace app sched -o /data/local/tmp/wan_decode.chtrace
